review.method: Questions, reference answers, pages, and relevant chunks were manually compared with the two captured University of Leeds student pages and their deterministic Stage 02 chunks.

questions.question: Where should a student check whether planned maintenance is affecting Minerva?
questions.answer_reference: Check the Digital Education Systems help website for scheduled maintenance.

questions.question: Where are updates posted for an unplanned Minerva outage?
questions.answer_reference: Updates are posted during office hours on the IT service status page.

questions.question: Which teaching materials become unavailable when Minerva is down?
questions.answer_reference: Examples include lecture recordings, digitised course readings, and lecture slides.

questions.question: What details should a student record when Minerva fails during coursework submission?
questions.answer_reference: Take a screenshot and record the page, date, time, location, and PC number when using an IT cluster.

questions.question: What information should be included when reporting a failed Minerva submission to the IT service desk?
questions.answer_reference: Include the module code, assignment name, contact information, and the recorded error details.

questions.question: What should a student send their school if a Minerva problem may cause a missed deadline?
questions.answer_reference: Send the recorded issue details and the IT service desk reference number to the school teaching the module.

questions.question: What evidence should a student keep after eventually submitting their work?
Where is a student directed if they need help registering as a student?
questions.answer_reference: They are directed to the how-to-register page.

questions.question: Can students still access module reading lists and past exam papers while Minerva is unavailable?
questions.answer_reference: Yes. Direct links for module reading lists and past exam papers are provided.

questions.question: Which team should an online learner contact about Minerva or Coursera access?
questions.answer_reference: Contact the Enhancement and Course Support Team at DESCourseSupport@leeds.ac.uk.

questions.question: Who handles online-course questions about registration, enrolment, extensions, or assessments?
questions.answer_reference: The Student Education and Experience Team handles those administrative questions.

questions.question: When do the online learning support teams work and how quickly do they aim to respond?
questions.answer_reference: They work Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm UK time, and aim to respond within two working days.
